# versioning

Versioning as a declared strategy - URI/header/media-type placement and semver applied to the contract, not the implementation.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-REST-007` — Versioning is a declared strategy, not an accident (medium)

Mixing `/v1` prefixes, media-type versions and silent field changes in one API makes the compatibility contract unanswerable — consumers cannot tell what is stable.

Remediation: Pick one strategy (URI prefix recommended for HTTP APIs), apply it uniformly, and record the deprecation policy next to the contract.

Reference: docs/decisions/ADR-002-api-ir-provenance.md

### `AF-BREAK-006` — Semantic-version the contract, not the implementation (medium)

Consumers reason about the API surface, not internals — major bumps for breaking changes, minor for additions, patch for clarifications; reusing an implementation version confuses that signal.

Remediation: Version the contract document independently; bump `info.version` per the change class `diff contract` reports.

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md
